content.title: 前景执念对抗背景灾难｜危险升级但微小任务不断线
content.summary: 把一名明确成年原创人物和一个微小、可持续操作的前景任务锁在画面中心，让背景危险从人群混乱、横穿武器、爆炸到贴脸擦过逐级升级；人物只做必要闪避并始终返回同一任务，结尾危险退去而注意力依旧不变，以尺度与行为反差形成喜剧。

quick_start.input_format: 明确成年原创主体和一个小型可重复前景任务先建立 + 背景危险至少经过三档接近等级升级且方向可读 + 每次危险后双手与视线都回到同一任务物 + 早期只做最小避让并把最大身体位移保留给一次近接峰值 + 危险过去后重新执行原任务而非庆祝或击败威胁
quick_start.recommended_input: 成年温室技术员在中央校准琥珀湿度计，仪表屏幕、双手和低头视线清楚；空推车横穿中景，技术员只转一个肩膀避让，然后恢复同一正面任务；技术员恢复站直、低头并继续校准，湿地与远处喷淋逐渐稳定
required_anchors: Establish one clearly adult original protagonist and one small repeatable foreground task before hazards escalate.
Escalate at least three hazards from background activity to near contact while keeping their direction legible.
Use the minimum avoidance needed until one near-contact peak causes the largest body displacement.
End with the adult resuming the task after danger passes, not celebrating or defeating the threat.
usage_steps: 把示例主体、场景和表层元素替换为原创概念。
让每个必需锚点和 Creative DNA 不可变条件都能在画面因果链中被看见。
选择 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 模板，只填写已声明的可替换项。
生成前检查时长、事件顺序、镜头连续性、声音和反复制约束。
applicable_scope: 把一名明确成年原创人物和一个微小、可持续操作的前景任务锁在画面中心，让背景危险从人群混乱、横穿武器、爆炸到贴脸擦过逐级升级；人物只做必要闪避并始终返回同一任务，结尾危险退去而注意力依旧不变，以尺度与行为反差形成喜剧。
能够保留全部必需锚点的原创 4–15 秒短片。
需要可复用因果视频结构的 MiniMax H3 或 Seedance 2.0 项目。
not_suitable_for: 要求复制来源人物、场景、道具、对白或镜头顺序的任务。
无法在目标时长内展示全部必需锚点的概念。
缺少紧凑因果链的长篇讲解或无关多地点叙事。

creative_dna.mechanism: 将明确成年原创人物和一个极小前景动作锁在中心，后景从纸张、家具移动到人群奔跑逐级升压；人物只作必要响应并回到原节奏。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult original lead remains centered and identifiable.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult original lead remains centered and identifiable."

invariants.rule: A small foreground action stays continuous.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A small foreground action stays continuous."

invariants.rule: Background disorder escalates in readable stages.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Background disorder escalates in readable stages."

invariants.rule: Conflict remains non-graphic and safely choreographed.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Conflict remains non-graphic and safely choreographed."

invariants.rule: The ending returns to the foreground task and pose.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The ending returns to the foreground task and pose."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
